description: Returns the applications to the Tbilisi Architecture Service for a parcel or a period, newest first: building permits, project approvals, signs, fences, and requests for public information. Give a cadastral code (01.18.04.020.005), a period of at most 31 days, or both. A period of more than 500 applications fails, and Tbilisi registers about 70 each working day, so ask for a week at most. Each application has its number, address, status, category, class, and stages. Read the decision with permits_get_application. Tbilisi only. Texts are in Georgian. Data from TAS.

code.description: The cadastral code of the parcel: 4 or 5 groups of digits with dots, as 01.18.04.020.005.

from.description: The first date of registration, YYYY-MM-DD. Without to, the period is 7 days.

limit.description: The maximum count of applications, 1 to 50. The default is 10.

to.description: The last date of registration, YYYY-MM-DD. Without from, the period is 7 days.

name: permits_search_applications

action.description: The action, in Georgian, as a change of an approved project.

address.description: The address, in Georgian, as TAS publishes it.

category.description: The kind of object or work, in Georgian.

class.description: The class of risk, I to IV.

deadline.description: The date by which TAS must answer, YYYY-MM-DD.

executor.description: The employee of TAS who handles the application.

parent_category.description: The group of the category, in Georgian.

stages.description: The stages that the application covers, in Georgian.

status.description: approved, refused, deficient, conditional, not_reviewed, revoked, completed, awaiting_payment, or in_review.

name.description: The name of the code at TAS, in Georgian.

url.description: The page of the application on tas.ge.

as_of.description: The instant at which the server read the applications, RFC 3339.

source.description: The source of the data: TAS.

stale.description: True when TAS did not answer and the server returns applications it read before.

total.description: The count of all the applications that match.

title: Search the building applications of Tbilisi
